user_query: I am a fashion blogger and I need some inspiration for outfit ideas and styling tips. Can you search for pins related to fashion trends and outfit inspirations? Additionally, I would like to get the profile information of my favorite fashion influencer's Pinterest account to see their saved pins and boards.

TaskList.description: Search for pins related to fashion trends and outfit inspirations on Pinterest.
Retrieve the profile information of the specified fashion influencer's Pinterest account.
Get the saved pins and boards from the fashion influencer's Pinterest profile.
